_about: Loop 3g-1: the speed traps of docs/design/police.md section 2, found by road name in today's lane graph (game/map/centrum.json `graph`; the `graph_edge` is only where they were measured). Each trap: the patrol car parked on the kerb side (`car`, map metres; 1.5 m past the outer lane's edge, facing the traffic: `car_heading`, compass degrees, 0 north, 90 east), the traffic it measures (`direction`, a unit vector on the map, x east, z south; `measured`), the officer 3 m upstream at the kerb (`officer`), where --trap=N starts the car, 150 m before the officer heading into the radar (`start`, `start_heading`), the speed limit there and the radio host's phrases (Polish, English). Spots 5-7 lie in the demo area (loop 3d): no spot yet, so the game skips them. Loop 3d moves these into the bake as `pois` kind `trap` (police.md section 13) and this file goes.
